correctness.rationale: The frozen proof reconstructs the identity tr L_FF^{-1}=Σ_{v not leader}R_eff(v,S) for any nonempty grounded leader set. Tree deletion splits follower components. On each arm, open leader interval has explicit parallel resistance sum B_i(a,b), free tail cost Q_i(a), giving an acyclic exact path DP F_i(t,s). If center is leader, arms decouple. If center is follower, the triple of first leader positions (or ∞) determines every center-component resistance using conductance sum G, while distal components again use F_i. Exhaustion of O(N^3) first leader triples with three-arm O(k²) convolutions yields O(N^4+N^3 k²)=O(N^5) exact arithmetic operations and reconstructs an argmin. Independent rational Laplacian inversions on the unweighted arms (1,1,4) confirmed the unique one-leader optimum {3}, trace 11 and the disjoint unique two-leader optimum {0,5}, trace 13/3. Finite tests are corroboration; exhaustive structural case decomposition supplies arbitrary N,k,positive real weights.

originality.rationale: Patterson–McGlohon–Dyagilev 2017 full original IEEE paper proves polynomial leader selection on weighted paths and rings, excluding degree-three branching. Patterson–Yi–Zhang arXiv:1708.06873 full HTML explicitly treats arbitrary k on cycles and paths and exactly TWO leaders on perfect M-ary trees (Section IV-C), not all k on arbitrarily weighted tripods. Fitch–Leonard is a given-set score, not exact optimizer. Resultary searches found no dominating all-k weighted tripod theorem. Sun–Li–Zheng 2021 discusses structured symmetric/asymmetric tree placements but full text inaccessible; material read is limited to abstract, a named priority risk, not automatic failure. Thus best-of-knowledge O PASS for complete weighted branching all-budget optimization and nonnested witness.
residual_risks: Sun–Li–Zheng (2021) complete tree-coherence text inaccessible due authorization/VPN; its scope cannot be fully excluded.
Earlier algorithmic work on weighted spiders or tree k-medians could specialize to this inverse-resistance objective under an unindexed reduction.

value.rationale: Weighted noisy-consensus leader optimization is a motivated design problem. A single genuine branch makes path-only DP insufficient because arm resistances couple at the follower center. The theorem gives a nonexponential exact all-k weighted tripod optimizer plus a small sharp nonnested-optimality counterexample to greedy augmentation. These are structural algorithmic and counterexample contributions beyond routine substitution.

limitations: Exactly three nonempty arms, strictly positive finite conductances, ideal noise-free leaders, exact-real arithmetic O(N^5) not rational bit complexity; not a generic-tree or directed-graph claim.
